verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is itself an agent-building framework (the MCP client role, not a server role). All MCP evidence shows the agent connecting to/wrapping external MCP servers as tools (livekit-agents-gh-1, livekit-agents-docs-17/23/34), which is client-side usage and belongs to a separate MCP-client story — there is no evidence LiveKit Agents itself runs as an MCP server exposed for other agents to connect to, so the 'official MCP server' axis does not apply to this product role.
